name: ascii-cloth
title: ASCII Cloth
description: A hanging sheet of characters that stretches when dragged, with a word woven into the fabric.

useCases: Interactive fabric illustrations for identity, portfolio, and hero sections.
limitations: The woven word is limited to 24 printable ASCII characters on one row.
requirements: Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Supply a pause control for motion; reduced motion shows static cloth.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/ascii-cloth.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
